// Article-specific bespoke detection — n8n Sandbox Escape Lets Workflow Editors Run OS Commands as the n8n Process

DeviceProcessEvents

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")

title: n8n Node.js Process Spawning Shell or Download Utility (Sandbox Escape)
id: 6b1d2f4a-9c3e-4f77-bd21-8a5f0e2c9d11
description: Detects the n8n Node.js runtime spawning an interactive shell or curl/wget/PowerShell, consistent with GHSA-gv7g-jm28-cr3m expression-sandbox escape to OS command execution.
references:
  - https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-gv7g-jm28-cr3m
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/n8n-sandbox-escape-lets-workflow.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/27
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|contains: 'node'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'n8n'
  child:

      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '\cmd.exe'

      - '/pwsh'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
